Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies v1.0 (350-601)
Exam Description:
Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies v1.0 (DCCOR 350-601) is a 120-minute exam associated with the CCNP and CCIE Data Center Certifications. This exam tests a candidate's knowledge of implementing core data center technologies including network, compute, storage network, automation, and security. The course, Implementing Cisco Data Center Core Technologies, helps candidates to prepare for this exam.
25% 1.0 Network
1.1 Apply routing protocols
1.2 Apply switching protocols such as RSTP+, LACP and vPC
1.3 Apply overlay protocols such as VXLAN EVPN and OTV
1.4 Apply ACI concepts
1.5 Analyze packet flow (unicast, multicast, and broadcast)
1.6 Analyze Cloud service and deployment models (NIST 800-145)
1.7 Describe software updates and their impacts
1.8 Implement network configuration management
1.9 Implement infrastructure monitoring such as NetFlow and SPAN
1.10 Explain network assurance concepts such as streaming telemetry
25% 2.0 Compute
2.1 Implement Cisco Unified Compute System Rack Servers
2.2 Implement Cisco Unified Compute System Blade Chassis
2.3 Explain HyperFlex Infrastructure Concepts and benefits (Edge and Hybrid Architecture vs all-flash)
2.4 Describe firmware and software updates and their impacts on B-Series and C-Series servers
2.5 Implement compute configuration management (Backup and restore)
2.6 Implement infrastructure monitoring such as SPAN and Intersight
20% 3.0 Storage Network
3.1 Implement Fibre Channe
3.2 Implement FCoE Unified Fabric (FIP and DCB)
3.3 Describe NFS and NAS concepts
3.4 Describe software updates and their impacts (Disruptive/nondisruptive and EPLD)
3.5 Implement infrastructure monitoring
15% 4.0 Automation
4.1 Implement automation and scripting tools
4.2 Evaluate automation and orchestration technologies
15% 5.0 Security
5.1 Apply network security
5.2 Apply compute security
5.3 Apply storage security
FAQ
1. What is the eligibility criteria for CCNP Data Center Certification?
To be eligible for CCNP Data Center certification, candidates must meet the following prerequisites: 1. Valid CCNA Data Center certification or any Cisco CCIE certification.
2. Pass four exams:
• Core Exam: Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies (DCCOR 350-601)
• Concentration Exam: Choose one from the following:
o Designing Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCID 300-610)
o Troubleshooting Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCIT 300-615)
o Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (DCACI 300-620)
o Implementing Cisco Storage Area Networking (DCSAN 300-625)
Candidates must pass the core exam and one concentration exam of their choice to earn CCNP Data Center certification.
It's important to note that there are no formal prerequisites for taking the exams, but Cisco recommends that candidates have at least three to five years of experience working with data center technologies and solutions. Additionally, candidates should have a solid understanding of Cisco data center technologies, such as virtualization, storage networking, and network security. Be sure to review the latest eligibility requirements and exam policies on the Cisco website before scheduling your CCNP Data Center exams.
2. What is the training duration for CCNP Data Center Certification?
The training duration for CCNP Data Center certification can vary depending on the individual's experience and learning style. However, Cisco recommends that candidates have at least three to five years of experience working with data center technologies and solutions before pursuing this certification. To prepare for the CCNP Data Center exams, candidates can take instructor-led training courses, online self-paced courses, or a combination of both. Cisco offers a range of training options that cover the exam topics in detail, including:
• Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies (DCCOR 350-601) - This is the core exam for CCNP Data Center certification and covers topics such as network design, virtualization, compute platforms, and storage networking.
• Concentration exams - Candidates must pass one concentration exam of their choice. The available concentration exams cover topics such as data center infrastructure design, troubleshooting, application-centric infrastructure, and storage area networking.
The duration of these courses can vary from a few days to several weeks, depending on the course format and intensity. Candidates can also choose to study on their own using Cisco's official study materials, such as books, practice exams, and online resources.
Overall, the training duration for CCNP Data Center certification can range from a few weeks to several months, depending on the individual's experience level, study habits, and availability. It's important to allocate sufficient time for exam preparation to ensure success on the certification exams.
3. What are the benefits of CCNP Data Center Certification?
CCNP Data Center certification is a valuable credential for IT professionals who want to demonstrate their expertise in designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions. Some of the key benefits of earning this certification include:
1. Enhanced job opportunities: CCNP Data Center certification can open up new job opportunities in the IT industry, particularly in roles that involve designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions.
2. Increased earning potential: Holding CCNP Data Center certification can increase earning potential, as certified professionals are highly sought after by employers looking to hire skilled and experienced data center professionals.
3. Industry recognition: CCNP Data Center certification is recognized as a standard of excellence in the IT industry, and holding this certification can help professionals stand out from their peers and demonstrate their expertise.
4. Expanded knowledge and skills: Pursuing CCNP Data Center certification requires extensive knowledge and understanding of data center technologies and solutions, which can help professionals expand their knowledge and skills in this area.
5. Professional development: Earning CCNP Data Center certification requires a significant investment of time and effort, and the certification process can help professionals develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills that are highly valued in the IT industry.
Overall, CCNP Data Center certification is an excellent way for IT professionals to validate their expertise and increase their marketability in a highly competitive job market. It can help professionals take their careers to the next level and achieve their professional goals.
4. What job opportunities are available for CCNP Data Center certified professionals?
CCNP Data Center certified professionals are in high demand due to their expertise in designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions. Some of the job opportunities available for CCNP Data Center certified professionals include:
1. Data Center Network Engineer: As a Data Center Network Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing data center networks, including virtualization, routing, switching, and security.
2. Data Center Systems Administrator: As a Data Center Systems Administrator, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining data center hardware and software, including servers, storage, and backup systems.
3. Data Center Solutions Architect: As a Data Center Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing data center solutions that meet the needs of the organization, including hardware, software, and networking infrastructure.
4. Data Center Security Engineer: As a Data Center Security Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing data center security solutions, including firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and access control systems.
5. Data Center Storage Engineer: As a Data Center Storage Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing data center storage solutions, including storage area networks (SANs), network-attached storage (NAS), and backup and recovery systems.
6. Data Center Virtualization Engineer: As a Data Center Virtualization Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing virtualization solutions in the data center, including server virtualization, storage virtualization, and network virtualization.
Overall, CCNP Data Center certification can open up a wide range of job opportunities in the IT industry, particularly in roles that involve designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions.
5. What is the course curriculum for CCNP Data Center Certification?
The CCNP Data Center certification program consists of four exams that cover a wide range of topics related to designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions. The course curriculum includes the following topics: 1. Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies (DCCOR): This exam covers the following topics:
• Data Center Network Architecture
• Network Design and Topologies
• Cisco Data Center Infrastructure
• Virtualization and Automation
• Unified Computing
• Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI)
• Network Services
2. Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (DCACI): This exam covers the following topics:
• ACI Architecture and Design
• ACI Packet Forwarding
• ACI External Connectivity
• ACI Network Policies
• ACI Management
3. Designing Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCID): This exam covers the following topics:
• Data Center Design Concepts
• Data Center Network Design
• Data Center Storage Network Design
• Data Center Compute Connectivity Design
• Data Center Services Design
4. Troubleshooting Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCIT): This exam covers the following topics:
• Data Center Network Troubleshooting
• Data Center Storage Troubleshooting
• Data Center Compute Troubleshooting
• Data Center Automation and Orchestration Troubleshooting
Overall, the CCNP Data Center certification program covers a wide range of topics related to designing, implementing, and managing data center solutions, including network architecture, virtualization, automation, storage, compute, and application-centric infrastructure. The program is designed to equip IT professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in a variety of roles in the data center industry.
6. What are the different training modes available for CCNP Data Center Certification?
There are different training modes available for CCNP Data Center Certification, depending on your learning preferences and availability. These include: 1. Instructor-led training (ILT): This is a traditional classroom-based training mode where a certified instructor delivers the course material to a group of students. ILT is ideal for learners who prefer a structured learning environment and the opportunity to ask questions and interact with other students.
2. Virtual instructor-led training (VILT): This is similar to ILT, but the course is delivered online using web conferencing software. VILT is ideal for learners who cannot attend a physical classroom due to geographic or scheduling constraints.
3. Self-paced online training: This training mode allows learners to access course material online and study at their own pace. Self-paced training is ideal for learners who prefer flexibility and the ability to study on their own schedule.
4. Cisco Learning Labs: Cisco Learning Labs is an online platform that provides learners with access to virtual lab environments for hands-on practice. Cisco Learning Labs are ideal for learners who want to gain practical experience working with Cisco data center technologies.
5. Boot camps: Boot camps are intensive training programs that cover the entire CCNP Data Center course curriculum in a short period of time. Boot camps are ideal for learners who want to prepare for the certification exams quickly.
Overall, there are several training modes available for CCNP Data Center Certification, each with its own advantages and disadvantages. The choice of training mode depends on your learning preferences, availability, and budget.
7. What is the validity of CCNP Data Center Certification?
The CCNP Data Center Certification is valid for three years from the date of certification. After the expiration of the certification, the holder must recertify to maintain the certification's validity. Recertification can be achieved by passing any professional-level Cisco certification exam or higher-level exam, passing any CCIE written or lab exam, or passing a current CCDE written or practical exam. Alternatively, recertification can also be achieved by earning continuing education credits through approved Cisco training programs or activities. It's important to note that Cisco regularly updates its certification programs to reflect changes in technology and industry best practices. As a result, holders of CCNP Data Center Certification must keep their skills up to date to remain relevant in the field.
8. What is the registration process for CCNP Data Center Certification?
To register for the CCNP Data Center Certification, follow these steps: 1. Choose the exam you want to take: The CCNP Data Center Certification consists of four exams. Choose the exam(s) that you want to take and check the exam requirements on the Cisco website.
2. Create an account on the Cisco website: If you don't have a Cisco account, create one on the Cisco website.
3. Schedule your exam: After creating an account, log in and schedule your exam through the Cisco website or Pearson VUE website. You will need to provide personal information, choose the exam location, and select a date and time.
4. Pay the exam fee: Pay the exam fee through the Cisco website or Pearson VUE website. The exam fee varies depending on the exam you are taking and your location.
5. Prepare for the exam: Use Cisco's official study materials or other reputable study resources to prepare for the exam.
6. Take the exam: Arrive at the exam location on the scheduled date and time and take the exam.
7. Receive your certification: If you pass the exam, you will receive your certification from Cisco via email or through the Cisco website.
It's important to note that the registration process may vary slightly depending on your location and the exam you are taking. Always refer to the Cisco website for the most up-to-date information on exam registration.
9. Are there any prerequisites for CCNP Data Center Certification?
Yes, there are prerequisites for the CCNP Data Center Certification. Candidates must have a valid Cisco CCNA Data Center certification or any Cisco CCIE certification before taking any CCNP Data Center exams.
The CCNA Data Center certification can be obtained by passing the following two exams:
• Implementing and Administering Cisco Solutions (CCNA) exam (200-301)
• Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies (DCCOR) exam (350-601)
Alternatively, candidates can obtain the CCIE certification before taking the CCNP Data Center exams. However, it's important to note that the CCIE certification is a more advanced and rigorous certification than the CCNP, and it requires a higher level of knowledge and experience.
Before attempting the CCNP Data Center Certification, candidates should also have a good understanding of networking fundamentals and data center technologies, as well as practical experience in deploying and managing data center technologies.
10. What is the exam format for CCNP Data Center Certification?
The CCNP Data Center Certification consists of four exams, each with a different format. Here are the details of each exam format: 1. Implementing and Operating Cisco Data Center Core Technologies (DCCOR) exam (350-601):
• The exam consists of 90-110 questions.
• The exam duration is 120 minutes (2 hours).
• The questions are in multiple-choice and simulation format.
• The exam measures a candidate's knowledge of data center technologies including network, compute, storage network, automation, and security.
2. Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (DCACI) exam (300-620):
• The exam consists of 60-70 questions.
• The exam duration is 90 minutes (1.5 hours).
• The questions are in multiple-choice and simulation format.
• The exam measures a candidate's knowledge of Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) architecture, fabric, and protocols.
3. Designing Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCID) exam (300-610):
• The exam consists of 60-70 questions.
• The exam duration is 90 minutes (1.5 hours).
• The questions are in multiple-choice and simulation format.
• The exam measures a candidate's knowledge of data center infrastructure design including network, compute, storage, and security.
4. Troubleshooting Cisco Data Center Infrastructure (DCIT) exam (300-615):
• The exam consists of 60-70 questions.
• The exam duration is 90 minutes (1.5 hours).
• The questions are in multiple-choice and simulation format.
• The exam measures a candidate's knowledge of troubleshooting data center technologies including network, compute, storage network, automation, and security.
It's important to note that the exam format and number of questions are subject to change. Always check the Cisco website for the most up-to-date information on exam formats and requirements.
11. What skills and knowledge will I gain from CCNP Data Center Certification?
The CCNP Data Center Certification is designed to provide candidates with a comprehensive understanding of data center technologies and infrastructure. Upon completing this certification, candidates will have gained the following skills and knowledge:
1. Data Center Network Architecture: Candidates will gain knowledge of data center network design, architecture, and infrastructure components. They will learn how to design and deploy data center networks using Cisco data center products.
2. Data Center Storage Networking: Candidates will learn about storage networking technologies such as Fibre Channel, FCoE, iSCSI, and NAS. They will gain knowledge of storage network design, architecture, and deployment.
3. Data Center Compute: Candidates will learn about data center compute technologies including servers, virtualization, and automation. They will gain knowledge of server deployment, management, and optimization.
4. Data Center Automation and Orchestration: Candidates will learn about data center automation and orchestration technologies such as Cisco UCS Director and Cisco UCS Central. They will gain knowledge of automation and orchestration principles, frameworks, and best practices.
5. Data Center Security: Candidates will learn about data center security technologies and best practices. They will gain knowledge of security principles, access control, and network security.
6. Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI): Candidates will learn about Cisco ACI architecture, fabric, and protocols. They will gain knowledge of ACI design, deployment, and management.
By gaining these skills and knowledge, CCNP Data Center certified professionals will be able to design, deploy, and manage data center infrastructure and technologies. They will be equipped to handle complex data center environments and troubleshoot issues that arise in these environments.
12. How is the CCNP Data Center Certification different from other Cisco certifications?
The CCNP Data Center Certification is a specialized certification from Cisco that focuses on data center technologies and infrastructure. It is designed for professionals who work with data center environments and need to have in-depth knowledge and skills in data center networking, storage networking, compute, automation and orchestration, security, and application-centric infrastructure. Compared to other Cisco certifications, such as CCNA or CCNP Routing and Switching, the CCNP Data Center Certification is more focused and specialized. While CCNA and CCNP Routing and Switching cover a broad range of networking technologies and principles, CCNP Data Center focuses exclusively on data center technologies and infrastructure. This means that CCNP Data Center certified professionals have a deep understanding of data center technologies and are equipped to handle complex data center environments. Additionally, the CCNP Data Center Certification requires candidates to pass four exams, each of which focuses on a specific area of data center technologies. This makes the certification more comprehensive and ensures that candidates have in-depth knowledge and skills in all areas of data center technologies. Overall, the CCNP Data Center Certification is a valuable credential for professionals who work with data center environments and need to have specialized knowledge and skills in data center technologies and infrastructure.

15. Can I take the CCNP Data Center Certification exam online?
Yes, you can take the CCNP Data Center Certification exam online. Cisco offers online proctored exams for the CCNP Data Center Certification, which allows you to take the exam from your home or office using a webcam and high-speed internet connection. To take the online proctored exam, you must meet the technical and testing environment requirements outlined by Cisco. This includes having a private and quiet testing environment, a computer with a webcam and microphone, and a stable internet connection. You will also need to install the Pearson VUE online proctoring software and complete a system check prior to the exam. It's important to note that online proctored exams have specific rules and guidelines to ensure the integrity of the exam. You will be monitored by a proctor throughout the exam, and any violations of the exam policies can result in your exam being invalidated. Overall, taking the CCNP Data Center Certification exam online can be a convenient option for those who may not have access to a testing center or prefer to take the exam from the comfort of their own space.
16. How long does it take to receive the CCNP Data Center Certification after passing the exam?
After passing the CCNP Data Center Certification exam, you should receive your certification within 2-5 business days. The certification will be issued electronically, and you will receive an email notification once it is available. You can access your certification through the Cisco Certification Tracking System, where you can also download a PDF copy of your certificate. It's important to ensure that your contact information is up to date in the system to ensure that you receive timely notifications regarding your certification. If you do not receive your certification within the expected timeframe, you can contact Cisco support for assistance.
17. What is the passing score for the CCNP Data Center Certification exam?
The passing score for the CCNP Data Center Certification exams is not publicly disclosed by Cisco. Cisco uses a scaled scoring system to calculate the passing score for each exam, which takes into account the difficulty of the questions on the exam. The scaled scoring system ensures that each candidate is evaluated fairly and objectively, regardless of the specific set of questions they receive on their exam. The score range for each exam is typically between 300-1000 points, with the passing score being set by Cisco based on statistical analysis and psychometric evaluation. It's important to note that achieving a passing score on the CCNP Data Center Certification exams requires a solid understanding of the exam topics and a thorough preparation using various study resources such as official Cisco study materials, practice exams, and hands-on experience.
18. Can I retake the CCNP Data Center Certification exam if I don't pass on my first attempt?
Yes, you can retake the CCNP Data Center Certification exam if you do not pass on your first attempt. Cisco allows candidates to retake any of their certification exams after a waiting period of at least five calendar days from the date of their previous attempt. However, there are certain restrictions and limitations to retaking the exam. For example, you must pay the full exam fee for each attempt, and you are not allowed to take the same exam more than three times in a twelve-month period. Additionally, if you pass the exam, you are not allowed to retake it to try to achieve a higher score. It's also important to note that retaking the exam may not always be the best strategy for passing. If you do not pass on your first attempt, it's a good idea to analyze your performance and identify areas where you need to improve your knowledge and skills. You can use this information to adjust your study plan and focus your efforts on areas that need improvement. Using official study materials and practice exams from Cisco can also help you better prepare for the exam and increase your chances of passing on your next attempt.
19. Will my CCNP Data Center Certification expire? If so, how can I renew it?
Yes, your CCNP Data Center Certification will expire after three years from the date of certification. To renew your certification, you must pass one of the following: 1. Pass any current CCIE written exam or CCIE lab exam or,
2. Pass any current CCNP concentration exam (excluding the CCNP Data Center concentration exams) or,
3. Pass any current 642-XXX professional-level or Cisco Specialist exam (excluding Sales Specialist exams or MeetingPlace Specialist exams, Implementing Cisco TelePresence Installations (ITI) exams, Cisco Leading Virtual Classroom Instruction exams, or any 650 online exams) or,
4. Pass any current CCIE Collaboration or CCIE Data Center written exam or lab exam or,
5. Pass any current CCDE written or practical exam or,
6. Pass the current Cisco Certified Architect (CCAr) interview and the CCAr board review.
It's important to note that passing any one of the above exams will renew all your Cisco certifications, including the CCNP Data Center Certification. Also, you can attempt the renewal exam up to six months before your certification expiration date.

Implementing and Operating Cisco Service Provider Network Core Technologies v1.0 (350-501)
Exam Description:
Implementing and Operating Cisco Service Provider Network Core Technologies v1.0 (SPCOR 350-501) is a 120-minute exam associated with the CCNP and CCIE Service Provider Certifications. This exam tests a candidate's knowledge of implementing core service provider network technologies including core architecture, services, networking, automation, quality of services, security, and network assurance. The course, Implementing and Operating Cisco Service Provider Network Core Technologies, helps candidates to prepare for this exam.
15% 1.0 Architecture
1.1 Describe service provider architectures
1.2 Describe Cisco network software architecture
1.3 Describe service provider virtualization
1.4 Describe QoS architecture
1.5 Configure and verify control plan security
1.6 Describe management plane security
1.7 Implement data plane security
30% 2.0 Networking
2.1 Implement IS-IS (IPv4 and IPv6)
2.2 Implement OSPF (v2 and v3)
2.3 Describe BGP path selection algorithm
2.4 Implement BGP (v4 and v6 for IBGP and EBGP)
2.5 Implement routing policy language and route maps (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
2.6 Troubleshoot routing protocols
2.7 Describe IPv6 transition (NAT44, NAT64, 6RD, MAP, and DS Lite)
2.8 Implement high availability
20% 3.0 MPLS and Segment Routing
3.1 Implement MPLS
3.2 Describe traffic engineering
3.3 Describe segment routing
20% 4.0 Services
4.1 Describe VPN services
4.2 Configure L2VPN and Carrier Ethernet
4.3 Configure L3VPN
4.4 Implement multicast services
4.5 Implement QoS services
15% 5.0 Automation and Assurance
5.1 Describe the programmable APIs used to include Cisco devices in network automation
5.2 Interpret an external script to configure a Cisco device using a REST API
5.3 Describe the role of Network Services Orchestration (NSO)
5.4 Describe the high-level principles and benefits of a data modeling language, such as YANG
5.5 Compare agent vs. agentless configuration management tools, such as Chef, Puppet, Ansible, and SaltStack
5.6 Describe data analytics and model-driven telemetry in service provider
5.7 Configure dial-in/out telemetry streams using gRPC
5.8 Configure and verify NetFlow/IPFIX
5.9 Configure and verify NETCONF and RESTCONF
5.10 Configure and verify SNMP (v2c/v3)
FAQ
1. What is CCNP Service Provider Training?
· CCNP Service Provider (Cisco Certified Network Professional Service Provider) Training is a certification program offered by Cisco Systems that provides advanced knowledge and skills to IT professionals to design, implement, and troubleshoot service provider networks. This program covers a range of topics such as advanced routing protocols, Quality of Service (QoS), Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS), and Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), among others.
· The CCNP Service Provider certification is intended for professionals who work in service provider organizations, including network engineers, network technicians, network administrators, and support engineers. This certification validates their ability to manage and operate complex service provider networks and demonstrates their expertise in Cisco technologies and solutions.
· By completing the CCNP Service Provider Training, IT professionals can enhance their career prospects and gain recognition for their skills and expertise. The training includes both theoretical and hands-on practical components, enabling candidates to gain a deep understanding of service provider networks and prepare them for real-world challenges.
· Overall, CCNP Service Provider Training is a valuable certification for IT professionals looking to advance their careers in the service provider industry and improve their knowledge and skills in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting service provider networks using Cisco technologies.
2. What are the prerequisites for CCNP Service Provider Training?
To Enroll in CCNP Service Provider (Cisco Certified Network Professional Service Provider) Training, candidates must meet certain prerequisites to ensure they have the necessary knowledge and skills to succeed in the program. The prerequisites for CCNP Service Provider Training include:
1. Valid CCNA Service Provider certification or any CCIE certification.
2. Basic knowledge of IP addressing, routing, and switching.
3. Familiarity with Cisco IOS XR software.
4. Experience working with service provider networks.
5. Understanding of networking protocols, including Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS), and Quality of Service (QoS).
6. Knowledge of Virtual Private Network (VPN) technologies and network security.
Candidates who do not have the above prerequisites can take the necessary training courses to gain the required knowledge and skills before enrolling in CCNP Service Provider Training.
Having the required prerequisites will help ensure that candidates are well-prepared for the CCNP Service Provider program and can make the most of the training. It also ensures that candidates have a solid foundation in service provider networking concepts and technologies, allowing them to advance their skills and knowledge in the field.
3. What topics are covered in CCNP Service Provider Training?
CCNP Service Provider (Cisco Certified Network Professional Service Provider) Training is designed to provide IT professionals with the advanced knowledge and skills required to design, implement, and troubleshoot complex service provider networks. The program covers a wide range of topics related to service provider networking, including:
1. IP routing technologies, including advanced routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and IS-IS.
2. MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) technologies, including MPLS Layer 3 VPNs, MPLS Layer 2 VPNs, MPLS Traffic Engineering (TE), and MPLS multicast.
3. Quality of Service (QoS) technologies, including classification, marking, policing, shaping, and congestion management.
4. Service Provider IPv6, including IPv6 addressing and routing, and transition technologies such as Dual Stack and 6PE/6VPE.
5. VPN (Virtual Private Network) technologies, including site-to-site VPNs and remote access VPNs.
6. Network security, including access control, firewall technologies, and intrusion prevention systems.
7. Network management, including network monitoring, device management, and network automation.
The training includes both theoretical and hands-on practical components to ensure that candidates gain a deep understanding of service provider networking concepts and technologies and can apply them to real-world scenarios. By completing CCNP Service Provider Training, IT professionals can demonstrate their expertise in service provider networking and advance their careers in the industry.

10. What is the validity of CCNP Service Provider certification?
The CCNP Service Provider certification is valid for three years from the date of certification. After this period, candidates must recertify to maintain their certification status. Recertification can be achieved by passing any one of the following exams:
1. Pass any current CCNP-level exam or
2. Pass any current 642-XXX Professional-level or Cisco Specialist exam (excluding Sales Specialist exams or Meeting Place Specialist exams, Implementing Cisco Telepresence Installations (ITI) exams, Cisco Leading Virtual Classroom Instruction exams, or any 650 online exams).
Alternatively, candidates can also recertify by passing a current CCIE written exam or CCDE written or practical exam.
It is important to note that recertification is necessary to maintain the validity of the CCNP Service Provider certification. Failing to recertify before the certification expiration date can result in the certification becoming inactive, which can impact job opportunities and career growth.
In summary, the CCNP Service Provider certification is valid for three years, and candidates must recertify to maintain their certification status. Recertification can be achieved by passing certain exams or by passing a current CCIE or CCDE written or practical exam.

Cisco Certified Network Professional
(CCNP) Collaboration is a certification program that validates the knowledge and skills required to design, implement, and
troubleshoot collaboration technologies
. The
CCNP Collaboration program
focuses on key technologies used in modern collaboration environments, including IP telephony, video, unified messaging, presence, and contact centre.
If you're interested in pursuing a career in collaboration technologies, the
CCNP Collaboration certification
can help you gain the knowledge and skills needed to design, implement, and troubleshoot complex collaboration networks. This certification program is intended for network engineers, network administrators, and network support professionals who work in collaboration environments.
The CCNP Collaboration certification requires candidates to pass four exams:
Implementing Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies
(350-801 CLCOR)
Implementing Cisco Collaboration Applications
(300-810 CLICA)
Designing Cisco Collaboration Solutions
(300-820 CLCEI)
Troubleshooting Cisco Collaboration Solutions
(300-835 CLAUTO)
Download CCNP Collaboration Content
To prepare for the exams, candidates can take advantage of a variety of resources, including
online training courses, practice exams, study guides, and lab equipment.
Cisco also offers authorized learning partners who provide training and certification programs for CCNP Collaboration.
Benefits of
CCNP Collaboration certification
include enhanced knowledge and skills in collaboration technologies, career advancement opportunities, professional credibility, networking opportunities, keeping up with the latest technology, and increased confidence.

Implementing Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies v1.0 (350-801)
Exam Description:
Implementing Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies v1.0 (CLCOR 350-801) is a 120-minute exam associated with the CCNP and CCIE Collaboration Certifications. This exam tests a candidate's knowledge of implementing core collaboration technologies including infrastructure and design, protocols, codecs, and endpoints, Cisco IOS XE gateway and media resources, Call Control, QoS, and collaboration applications. The course, Implementing Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies, helps candidates to prepare for this exam.
20% 1.0 Infrastructure and Design
1.1 Describe the key design elements of the following, pertaining to the Cisco Collaboration architecture as described in the SRND/PA
1.2 Describe the purpose of Edge devices in the Cisco Collaboration architecture such as Expressway and Cisco Unified Border Element
1.3 Configure these network components to support Cisco Collaboration solutions
1.4 Troubleshoot these network components in a Cisco Collaboration solution
1.5 Explain these components to support Cisco Collaboration solutions
20% 2.0 Protocols, Codecs, and Endpoints
2.1 Troubleshoot these elements of a SIP conversation
2.2 Identify the appropriate collaboration codecs for a given scenario
2.3 Configure codec negotiations
2.4 Deploy SIP endpoints
2.5 Troubleshoot collaboration endpoints
15% 3.0 Cisco IOS XE Gateway and Media Resources
3.1 Configure these voice gateway elements
3.2 Configure ISDN PRI/BRI
3.3 Troubleshoot ISDN PRI/BRI
3.4 Configure and verify the MGCP
3.5 Identify the appropriate media resources for a given scenario (hardware and software)
25% 4.0 Call Control
4.1 Describe the Cisco Unified Communications Manager digit analysis process
4.2 Implement toll fraud prevention on Cisco Unified CM
4.3 Configure globalized call routing in Cisco Unified CM
4.4 Describe Mobile and Remote Access (MRA)
10% 5.0 QoS
5.1 Describe problems that can lead to poor voice and video quality
5.2 Describe the QoS requirements for these application types (voice and video)
5.3 Describe the class models for providing QoS on a network
5.4 Describe the purpose and function of these DiffServ values as it pertains to collaboration
5.5 Describe QoS trust boundaries and their significance in LAN-based classification and marking
5.6 Describe and determine location-based CAC bandwidth requirements
5.7 Configure and verify LLQ (class map, policy map, service policy)
10% 6.0 Collaboration Applications
6.1 Configure Cisco Unity Connection mailbox and MWI
6.2 Configure Cisco Unity Connection SIP integration options to call control
6.3 Describe Cisco Unity Connection call handlers
6.4 Describe Cisco Unified IM&P protocols and deployment
6.5 Deploy Cisco Jabber on premises
FAQ
1. What is CCNP Collaboration certification training, and why should I consider it?
CCNP Collaboration certification training is a professional certification program offered by Cisco that is designed to validate a candidate's expertise in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Cisco collaboration and unified communications solutions.
The CCNP Collaboration certification is designed for IT professionals who are responsible for managing and deploying Cisco collaboration and unified communication solutions, including IP telephony, video, messaging, and presence solutions. The certification covers a range of topics, including call control, Cisco Unified Communications Manager, Cisco Unity Connection, Cisco Unified IM and Presence, and Cisco Telepresence, among others.
There are several reasons why IT professionals should consider obtaining CCNP Collaboration certification. Some of these reasons include:
1. Career advancement: Obtaining CCNP Collaboration certification can enhance a candidate's career prospects by demonstrating their knowledge and expertise in Cisco collaboration and unified communications solutions. This can open opportunities for career advancement, higher salaries, and more challenging job roles.
2. Skill development: The CCNP Collaboration certification program provides candidates with in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in Cisco collaboration and unified communications solutions. This can help candidates to develop their skills and expertise in these areas, making them more valuable to organizations.
3. Industry recognition: Cisco certifications, including CCNP Collaboration, are widely recognized and respected in the IT industry. Holding this certification can help candidates to gain industry recognition and respect, enhancing their reputation and credibility among their peers and potential employers.
4. Network building: Cisco has a global network of partners and customers, which can provide CCNP Collaboration certified professionals with opportunities to work on projects and networks in different countries and regions. This can provide professionals with the opportunity to gain international experience and exposure, further enhancing their skills and expertise.
In conclusion, obtaining CCNP Collaboration certification can provide IT professionals with a range of benefits, including career advancement, skill development, industry recognition, and network building opportunities. It is an excellent certification to consider for IT professionals who are responsible for managing and deploying Cisco collaboration and unified communications solutions.
2. What are the eligibility criteria for CCNP Collaboration certification training?
The CCNP Collaboration certification training program is designed for IT professionals with a solid understanding of networking, particularly around collaboration and unified communication solutions. The eligibility criteria for the CCNP Collaboration certification training include:
1. A valid CCNA Collaboration certification or any Cisco CCIE certification can act as a prerequisite for CCNP Collaboration certification.
2. A minimum of three to five years of experience working with Cisco collaboration and unified communication solutions is recommended.
3. Candidates must possess a solid understanding of collaboration and unified communication technologies, including voice and video, call control, messaging, and conferencing.
4. Candidates must have a good understanding of IP networking technologies, protocols, and design concepts.
5. Knowledge of basic Linux operating system commands and network automation is also recommended.
It is important to note that meeting these eligibility criteria is not enough to earn the CCNP Collaboration certification. Candidates must pass the required exams, which test their proficiency in designing, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco collaboration and unified communication solutions. Overall, the CCNP Collaboration certification is an advanced-level certification that requires a significant commitment of time and effort but can offer many career benefits for IT professionals seeking to advance their skills and expertise in this field.
3. How long does the CCNP Collaboration certification training program take to complete?
· The duration of the CCNP Collaboration certification training program varies depending on the candidate's prior experience and level of expertise. The program consists of several courses and exams, which can take anywhere from a few months to a year or more to complete.
· The program typically involves extensive hands-on training and requires candidates to demonstrate their proficiency in designing, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco collaboration and unified communication solutions. It is recommended that candidates have at least three to five years of experience in networking, with a focus on collaboration and unified communication solutions, before pursuing the CCNP Collaboration certification.
· To earn the CCNP Collaboration certification, candidates must pass four exams: Implementing Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies (CLCOR 350-801), Implementing Cisco Collaboration Applications (CLICA 300-810), Implementing Cisco Advanced Call Control and Mobility Services (CLACCM 300-815), and Implementing Cisco Collaboration Cloud and Edge Solutions (CLCEI 300-820).
· Overall, the CCNP Collaboration certification training program is rigorous and requires a significant commitment of time and effort. However, it is an excellent program for IT professionals seeking to enhance their skills and expertise in Cisco collaboration and unified communications solutions and to advance their careers in this field.

Completing CCNP Collaboration certification training can open a range of job opportunities for IT professionals, as it demonstrates their expertise in working with Cisco collaboration solutions. 3. Unified Communications Manager: These professionals manage and support unified communications systems, including Cisco Unified Communications Manager, to provide voice and messaging services to an organization.
4. Voice Engineer: Voice engineers design and implement voice communication solutions, including Cisco collaboration solutions, to enable organizations to communicate effectively.

In summary, completing CCNP Collaboration certification training can lead to a range of job opportunities in the IT industry. Frequently Asked
Questions
1
What is CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and why should I consider it?
CIE Enterprise Infrastructure Certification Training is a comprehensive program designed for network engineers who wish to gain advanced knowledge and skills in enterprise-level networking technologies
.
The CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification is recognized worldwide and is considered the most prestigious certification in the networking industry. It is a highly sought-after credential for network engineers, architects, and managers who wish to demonstrate their expertise in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex enterprise-level networks.
• The CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification training provides in-depth knowledge of the latest networking technologies, including SD-WAN, network automation, network programmability, and security. It also covers a range of advanced topics such as network virtualization, cloud computing, and data center technologies.
• By pursuing the CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification, network professionals can enhance their career opportunities and potentially earn higher salaries. The certification is recognized by industry leaders and can help candidates stand out in a competitive job market. Additionally, the training provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with advanced networking technologies and learn from experienced instructors.
2
What are the eligibility criteria for CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure Certification Training?
• To be eligible for CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure Certification Training, candidates should have a solid understanding of networking technologies and protocols, along with a minimum of five years of professional experience in designing, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-level networks.
• In addition, candidates must pass a two-hour, written qualifying exam before becoming eligible to take the hands-on, eight-hour lab exam. The qualifying exam tests a candidate's knowledge of enterprise networking infrastructure and is designed to ensure that the candidate has the necessary skills and knowledge to successfully complete the lab exam.
• Candidates can also opt for the CCNP Enterprise certification as a prerequisite for the CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification. The CCNP Enterprise certification requires passing two exams - the Core exam and a concentration exam - and is designed to validate a candidate's knowledge and skills in implementing and troubleshooting enterprise-level networks.
• It's important to note that the eligibility criteria for the CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification may vary based on the country or region in which the candidate is located. It is recommended to check with the certification provider for the most up-to-date eligibility requirements.
3
How long does the CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure Certification Training program take to complete?
The CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training program is an advanced-level training program that focuses on providing in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience to networking professionals. The duration of the training program varies depending on the mode of delivery and the specific training provider. Generally, the program can take anywhere between 6-12 months to complete. However, some training providers may offer accelerated training programs that can be completed in a shorter period. It is important to research and choose a training provider that suits your learning needs and schedule.
4
Is the CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training program available online, and what are the benefits of online learning?
Yes, the CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training program is available online In Net Expert Solutions. Online learning has become increasingly popular in recent years, and it offers several benefits over traditional classroom-based learning. One of the main advantages of online learning is flexibility. With online learning, you can access course materials and lectures at your convenience, allowing you to balance your training with work and other commitments. Additionally, online learning is often more affordable than traditional classroom-based training, as there are no additional costs associated with travel or accommodation. Finally, online learning allows you to learn at your own pace, providing you with the opportunity to review and revise the course material as many times as necessary to fully understand the content.
5
What is the cost of CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and are there any additional expenses to consider?
The cost of CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training varies depending on the training provider, the mode of delivery, and the location. Typically, the cost ranges from a few thousand to tens of thousands of dollars. Additionally, you may need to consider additional expenses, such as exam fees, study materials, and equipment.
6
What topics are covered in CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and how do they prepare me for the certification exam?
CIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training covers a wide range of topics related to enterprise network infrastructure, including network design, architecture, routing, switching, security, automation, and virtualization. The training program includes hands-on lab exercises, case studies, and simulations that provide practical experience in implementing and troubleshooting complex network solutions. The program prepares you for the CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure certification exam by ensuring that you have a deep understanding of the topics covered and the skills required to pass the exam.
7
What study materials are provided with CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and how can I access them?
CIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training typically provides study materials such as textbooks, lab manuals, video tutorials, and practice exams. The training provider may provide these materials in hard copy or electronic format. You can access the materials online through a learning management system (LMS) or download them from the provider's website.

Who will be my instructors for CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and what are their qualifications and experience?
The instructors for CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training are typically Cisco-certified experts with extensive experience in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise network infrastructure solutions. They have in-depth knowledge of the topics covered in the training program and can provide hands-on guidance and feedback to help you succeed.

What job opportunities are available after completing CCIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training, and how can I prepare for them?
CIE Enterprise Certification Infrastructure Training opens a range of job opportunities for networking professionals, including network engineers, network architects, and network managers. To prepare for these roles, individuals should focus on developing their practical skills and knowledge in networking technologies and stay up to date with industry trends and developments. Networking with industry professionals and attending networking events can also help individuals in their career growth.

CCIE Security (v6.0) Exam Topics – Practical Exam
Exam Description:
The Cisco CCIE Security (v6.0) Practical Exam is an eight-hour, hands-on exam that requires a candidate to plan, design, deploy, operate, and optimize network security solutions to protect your network.
1. Perimeter Security and Intrusion Prevention (20%)
1.1 Deployment modes on Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.2 Firewall features on Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.3 Security features on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE
1.4 Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC) features
1.5 NGIPS deployment modes
1.6 Next Generation Firewall (NGFW) features
1.7 Detect, and mitigate common types of attacks
1.8 Clustering/HA features on Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.9 Policies and rules for traffic control on Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.10 Routing protocols security on Cisco IOS, Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.11 Network connectivity through Cisco ASA and Cisco FTD
1.12 Correlation and remediation rules on Cisco FMC
2. Secure Connectivity and Segmentation (20%)
2.1 AnyConnect client-based remote access VPN technologies on Cisco ASA, Cisco FTD, and Cisco Routers.
2.2 Cisco IOS CA for VPN authentication
2.3 FlexVPN, DMVPN, and IPsec L2L Tunnels
2.4 Uplink and downlink MACsec (802.1AE)
2.5 VPN high availability using
2.6 Infrastructure segmentation methods
2.7 Micro-segmentation with Cisco TrustSec using SGT and SXP
3. Infrastructure Security (15%)
3.1 Device hardening techniques and control plane protection methods
3.2 Management plane protection techniques
3.3 Inter Fabric connectivity
3.4 Layer 2 security techniques
3.5 Wireless security technologies
3.6 Monitoring protocols
3.7 Security features to comply with organizational security policies, procedures, and standards BCP 38
3.8 Cisco SAFE model to validate network security design and to identify threats to different Places in the Network (PINs)
3.9 Interaction with network devices through APIs using basic Python scripts
3.10 Cisco DNAC Northbound APIs use cases
4. Identity Management, Information Exchange, and Access Control (25%)
4.1 ISE scalability using multiple nodes and personas.
4.2 Cisco switches and Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers for network access AAA with ISE.
4.3 Cisco devices for administrative access with ISE
4.4 AAA for network access with 802.1X and MAB using ISE.
4.5 Guest lifecycle management using ISE and Cisco Wireless LAN controllers
4.6 BYOD on-boarding and network access flows
4.7 ISE integration with external identity sources
4.8 Provisioning of AnyConnect with ISE and ASA
4.9 Posture assessment with ISE
4.10 Endpoint profiling using ISE and Cisco network infrastructure including device sensor
4.11 Integration of MDM with ISE
4.12 Certificate-based authentication using ISE
4.13 Authentication methods
4.14 Identity mapping on ASA, ISE, WSA, and FTD
4.15 pxGrid integration between security devices WSA, ISE, and Cisco FMC
4.16 Integration of ISE with multi-factor authentication
4.17 Access control and single sign-on using Cisco DUO security technology
5. Advanced Threat Protection and Content Security (20%)
5.1 AMP for networks, AMP for endpoints, and AMP for content security (ESA, and WSA)
5.2 Detect, analyze, and mitigate malware incidents
5.3 Perform packet capture and analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, SPAN, ERSPAN, and RSPAN
5.4 DNS layer security, intelligent proxy, and user identification using Cisco Umbrella
5.5 Web filtering, user identification, and Application Visibility and Control (AVC) on Cisco FTD and WSA.
5.6 WCCP redirection on Cisco devices
5.7 Email security features
5.8 HTTPS decryption and inspection on Cisco FTD, WSA and Umbrella
5.9 SMA for centralized content security management
5.10 Cisco advanced threat solutions and their integration: Stealthwatch, FMC, AMP, Cognitive Threat Analytics (CTA), Threat Grid, Encrypted Traffic Analytics (ETA), WSA, SMA, CTR, and Umbrella
FAQ
1. What are the benefits of CCIE Security Certification for my career?
The CCIE Security Certification is a highly respected certification in the field of network security. It demonstrates an individual's knowledge and skills in designing, implementing, and managing security solutions using Cisco technologies. Having this certification can enhance your credibility and visibility in the industry, and may lead to better job opportunities, higher salaries, and career growth.
2. What skills and knowledge will I gain from the CCIE Security Certification Training program?
The CCIE Security Certification Training program covers a wide range of topics related to network security, including network infrastructure security, threat and vulnerability management, identity management, and secure network access. The training program is designed to provide individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to design, implement, and manage security solutions using Cisco technologies.
3. What are the prerequisites for the CCIE Security Certification Training?
To be eligible for the CCIE Security Certification Training, candidates must have a valid CCNP Security certification or equivalent knowledge and experience. Candidates must also pass a written exam before attempting the hands-on lab exam.
4. How long does the CCIE Security Certification Training program last?
The CCIE Security Certification Training program duration varies depending on the individual's pace of learning and schedule. It typically takes 6-12 months to complete.
5. What is the cost of CCIE Security Certification Training?
The cost of CCIE Security Certification Training varies depending on the training provider and location. It is essential to factor in additional expenses such as exam fees, study materials, and travel costs if attending in-person training sessions.
6. What is the format of the CCIE Security Certification Exam?
The CCIE Security Certification Exam consists of a written exam and a hands-on lab exam. The written exam is a two-hour, multiple-choice exam, while the hands-on lab exam is an eight-hour, scenario-based exam that tests an individual's ability to design, implement, and manage security solutions using Cisco technologies.
7. How many attempts can I make to clear the CCIE Security Certification Exam?
Candidates can attempt the CCIE Security Certification Exam up to three times within 12 months of their first attempt. After three attempts, candidates must wait 12 months before attempting the exam again.
8. How is the CCIE Security Certification Training delivered online?
The CCIE Security Certification Training is delivered online through live virtual classes, self-paced online learning modules, and hands-on lab practice. Live virtual classes are conducted by experienced instructors who use interactive teaching methods to engage students.
9. What kind of study materials will be provided during the CCIE Security Certification Training?
The CCIE Security Certification Training provides candidates with study materials such as training manuals, practice labs, and access to online resources. The training provider will provide access to study materials once the individual has enrolled in the program.
10. Is job assistance provided after completing the CCIE Security Certification Training program?
Many CCIE Security Certification Training providers offer job assistance to their students. This may include resume building, interview preparation, and networking opportunities with industry professionals. It is essential to check with the training provider to understand the extent of job assistance provided.

Exam Description:
The Cisco CCIE Data Center (v3.0) Practical Exam is an eight-hour, hands-on exam that requires a candidate to plan, design, deploy, operate, and optimize complex Data Center networks.
1. Data Center L2/L3 Connectivity (20%)
1.1 Layer 2 technologies

3.1 VRF lite
3.2 L3Out

3.4 Overlays
4. Data Center Compute (15%)
4.1 Compute Resources
4.2 Compute Connectivity
5. Data Center Storage Protocols and Features (10%)
5.1 FC and FCoE
5.2 iSCSI
5.3 RoCE v2 over IP Networks
6. Data Center Security and Network Services (10%)
6.1 Security features
6.2 RBAC
6.3 Network Services Insertion and Redirection
6.4 Services
6.5 Traffic management

7.1 Data center tasks using scripts (Python and Ansible)
7.2 Data Center Automation and Orchestration using tools
FAQ
1. What is CCIE Data Center Certification Training?
CCIE Data Center Certification Training is a comprehensive training program designed to prepare individuals to become experts in data center networking technologies. The training covers topics such as data center architecture, infrastructure, storage networking, and automation. The program aims to equip individuals with the knowledge and skills required to design, implement, and manage complex data center networks using Cisco technologies.
2. What are the prerequisites for enrolling in CCIE Data Center Certification Training?
To enroll in CCIE Data Center Certification Training, candidates must have a valid CCNA Data Center or CCNP Data Center certification or equivalent knowledge and experience. Candidates must also pass a written exam before attempting the hands-on lab exam.
3. What are the benefits of CCIE Data Center Certification Training?
CCIE Data Center Certification Training offers numerous benefits, including gaining a deeper understanding of data center networking technologies, enhanced skills, and knowledge, increased credibility in the industry, and better job prospects.
4. How long does CCIE Data Center Certification Training take?
The duration of CCIE Data Center Certification Training varies depending on the individual's pace of learning and schedule. It typically takes 6-12 months to complete the program.
5. What kind of study materials are provided in CCIE Data Center Certification Training?
CCIE Data Center Certification Training provides candidates with study materials such as training manuals, lab exercises, and access to online resources. The training provider will provide access to study materials once the individual has enrolled in the program.
6. Are there any practice exams or mock tests available in CCIE Data Center Certification Training?
Yes, many CCIE Data Center Certification Training providers offer practice exams and mock tests to help individuals prepare for the CCIE Data Center certification exam. These exams help individuals identify areas they need to focus on and build their confidence before attempting the actual exam.
7.How does CCIE Data Center Certification Training prepare me for the CCIE Data Center certification exam?
CCIE Data Center Certification Training covers all the topics required for the CCIE Data Center certification exam, including data center architecture, infrastructure, storage networking, and automation. The training program includes hands-on lab practice, which allows individuals to gain practical experience in designing, implementing, and managing data center networks.
8.What is the format of the CCIE Data Center certification exam?
The CCIE Data Center certification exam consists of a written exam and a hands-on lab exam. The written exam is a two-hour, multiple-choice exam, while the hands-on lab exam is an eight-hour, scenario-based exam that tests an individual's ability to design, implement, and manage data center networks using Cisco technologies.
9.How do I register for the CCIE Data Center certification exam?
Individuals can register for the CCIE Data Center certification exam on the Cisco website. Candidates must have a valid Cisco account and pay the exam fee to register.
10.What is the passing score for the CCIE Data Center certification exam?
The passing score for the CCIE Data Center certification exam is not disclosed by Cisco. However, it is essential to score well in both the written and hands-on lab exams to earn the certification.
11.What kind of job opportunities are available for CCIE Data Center certified professionals?
CCIE Data Center-certified professionals are in high demand in the industry, and many job opportunities are available. These include network engineer, data center engineer, data center architect, and network manager positions. CCIE Data Center certification opens opportunities for career growth, higher salaries, and better job prospects.

CCIE Service Provider (v5.0) Exam Topics – Practical Exam
Exam Description:
The Cisco CCIE Service Provider (v5.0) Practical Exam is an eight-hour, hands-on exam that requires a candidate to plan, design, implement, operate, and optimize dual stack solutions (IPv4 and IPv6) of complex Service Provider networks.
1. Core Routing (25%)
1.1 Interior Gateway Protocol
1.2 Border Gateway Protoco
1.3 Multicast
1.4 Multiprotocol Label Switching
1.5 MPLS Traffic Engineering

2.2 Large scale MPLS Architecture
2.3 Carrier Ethernet
2.4 L3VPN
2.5 Internet service
2.6 Multicast VPN
2.7 Quality of Service for Core, Distribution and Access
3. Access Connectivity (10%)
3.1 Layer-2 Connectivity
3.2 Layer-3 Connectivity
4. High Availability and Fast Convergence (10%)
4.1 High Availability
4.2 Routing/fast convergence
5. Security (10%)
5.1 Control plane security
5.2 Management plane security
5.3 Infrastructure security
6. Assurance and Automation (20%)
6.1 Network Assurance
6.2 Network Automation
FAQ
1. What is CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification?
CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification is a professional-level certification offered by Cisco Systems, which demonstrates advanced knowledge and skills in planning, designing, implementing, and operating complex service provider networks.
2. What are the eligibility requirements for CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification?
To be eligible for CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification, candidates must pass a written exam and a hands-on lab exam. There are no formal prerequisites for the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification, but candidates should have a strong foundation in networking technologies and several years of relevant work experience.
3.How long does it take to prepare for the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam?
The amount of time required to prepare for the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam can vary depending on a candidate's prior knowledge and experience. However, most candidates typically spend several months or more preparing for the exam.
4.What topics are covered in the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification training program?
The CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification training program covers a wide range of topics, including advanced routing and switching, service provider VPNs, MPLS, QoS, network security, and network management.
5. Who should Enroll in the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification training program?
The CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification training program is designed for experienced network professionals who are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining service provider networks.
6.What are the benefits of obtaining CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification?
CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification is widely recognized as a prestigious certification in the networking industry, which can open up new career opportunities and demonstrate advanced knowledge and skills in service provider networking technologies.
7.How difficult is the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam?
The CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam is one of the most challenging certification exams in the networking industry. It requires a deep understanding of complex networking technologies and a significant amount of hands-on experience.
8.What resources are available to help students prepare for the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam?
Cisco provides a variety of resources to help students prepare for the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam, including study materials, practice exams, and hands-on lab training.
9.What is the success rate for students who take the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam?
The success rate for students who take the CCIE Service Provider v5.0 Certification exam varies from year to year. However, the exam is widely considered to be challenging, and many candidates require multiple attempts to pass.
10.What are the job opportunities for CCIE Service Provider v5.0 certified professionals?
CCIE Service Provider v5.0 certified professionals are in high demand and can find job opportunities in a variety of industries, including telecommunications, cloud service providers, and data center hosting companies. Implementing Cisco SD-WAN Solutions v1.0 (300-415)
Exam Description:
Implementing Cisco SD-WAN Solutions v1.0 (ENSDWI 300-415) is a 90-minute exam associated with the CCNP Enterprise Certification. This exam certifies a candidate's knowledge of Cisco’s SD-WAN solution including SD-WAN architecture, controller deployment, edge router deployment, policies, security, quality or service, multicast and management and operations. The course, Implementing Cisco SD-WAN Solutions, helps candidates to prepare for this exam.
20% 1.0 Architecture
1.1 Describe Cisco SD-WAN Architecture and Components
1.2 Describe WAN Edge platform types, capabilities (vEdges, cEdges)
15% 2.0 Controller Deployment
2.1 Describe controller cloud deployment
2.2 Describe Controller on-Prem Deployment
2.3 Configure and verify certificates and whitelisting
2.4 Troubleshoot control-plane connectivity between controllers
20% 3.0 Router Deployment
3.1 Describe WAN Edge deployment
3.2 Configure and verify SD-WAN data plane
3.3 Configure and verify OMP
3.4 Configure and verify TLOCs
3.5 Configure and verify CLI and vManage feature configuration templates
20% 4.0 Policies
4.1 Configure and verify control policies
4.2 Configure and verify data policies
4.3 Configure and verify end-to-end segmentation
4.4 Configure and verify SD-WAN application-aware routing
4.5 Configure and verify direct Internet access
15% 5.0 Security and Quality of Service
5.1 Configure and verify service insertion
5.2 Describe application-aware firewall
5.3 Configure and verify QoS treatment on WAN edge routers
10% 6.0 Management and Operations
6.1 Describe monitoring and reporting from vManage
6.2 Configure and verify monitoring and reporting
6.3 Describe REST API monitoring
6.4 Describe software upgrade from vManage
FAQ
1. What is Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
Cisco SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Networking) Certification Training is a program that teaches IT professionals how to design, deploy, and troubleshoot Cisco SD-WAN solutions. The training focuses on the Cisco SD-WAN architecture, controller deployment, security, policies, quality of service (QoS), and migration from legacy WAN technologies.
2.Who is the intended audience for Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
The intended audience for Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training includes network engineers, network administrators, network architects, and IT professionals who are involved in WAN deployments.
3.What are the prerequisites for Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
There are no formal prerequisites for Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training. However, Cisco recommends that candidates have a basic understanding of networking technologies and concepts.
4.What are the benefits of getting certified in Cisco SD WAN?
Getting certified in Cisco SD-WAN can help IT professionals gain expertise in SD-WAN technologies and demonstrate their proficiency to employers. Certified professionals can also expand their career opportunities and increase their earning potential.
5.How long does Cisco SD WAN Certification Training typically take?
The duration of Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training varies depending on the training provider and the training format chosen. It can range from a few days to several weeks.
6.What topics are covered in Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training covers a range of topics, including the Cisco SD-WAN architecture, controller deployment, security, policies, quality of service (QoS), and migration from legacy WAN technologies.
7.Is there a certification exam for Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
Yes, there is a certification exam for Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training. The exam is designed to test the candidate's knowledge and skills related to Cisco SD-WAN technologies.
8.What is the format of the Cisco SD WAN Certification exam?
The Cisco SD-WAN Certification exam is a proctored, computer-based exam that consists of multiple-choice questions. The exam duration is 90 minutes.
9.What kind of job roles can one expect after getting certified in Cisco SD WAN?
After getting certified in Cisco SD-WAN, one can expect to work in roles such as Network Engineer, Network Administrator, Network Architect, and SD-WAN Engineer.
10.What is the cost of Cisco SD WAN Certification Training?
The cost of Cisco SD-WAN Certification Training varies depending on the training provider and the training format chosen. It typically ranges from a few hundred to a few thousand dollars. The cost of the certification exam is additional and varies depending on the location.

FAQ
1. What is Cisco SD Access Certification Training?
Cisco SD Access Certification Training is a program that helps individuals gain expertise in Cisco's Software-Defined Access (SD-Access) solution. It covers the implementation and operation of this solution in enterprise networks.
2. What prerequisites are required for this course?
To Enroll in the Cisco SD Access Certification Training, you should have a basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols. Familiarity with Cisco's routing and switching technologies is also beneficial.
3. What are the benefits of getting Cisco SD Access Certified?
The Cisco SD Access Certification demonstrates your proficiency in implementing and managing Cisco's SD-Access solution. It validates your knowledge of advanced networking concepts and helps you gain credibility in the industry. Additionally, it can enhance your career prospects and earning potential.
4. How long does it take to complete the Cisco SD Access Certification Training?
The duration of the Cisco SD Access Certification Training depends on the training provider and the learning format. Typically, it takes around 40-50 Hours to complete the training.
5. What topics are covered in the Cisco SD Access Certification Training?
The Cisco SD Access Certification Training covers the following topics: • Introduction to Software-Defined Access • SD-Access Architecture and Components • SD-Access Fabric Control Plane and Data Plane • Integration with Other Cisco Technologies • Policy-Based Segmentation and Automation • Advanced Troubleshooting Techniques
6. What kind of job roles can I get after completing Cisco SD Access Certification Training?
After completing the Cisco SD Access Certification Training, you can apply for job roles such as Network Engineer, Network Administrator, Network Consultant, and Network Architect.
7. Is there any exam I need to pass to become certified?
Yes, you need to pass the Cisco Certified Specialist - Enterprise SD-WAN Implementation exam (300-415 ENSDWI) to become Cisco SD Access certified.
8. What is the format of the Cisco SD Access Certification exam?
The Cisco SD Access Certification exam is a 90-minute test consisting of 60-70 multiple-choice and simulation questions.
9.What is the validity period of the Cisco SD Access Certification?
The Cisco SD Access Certification is valid for three years. After that, you need to recertify by passing a relevant exam or earning Continuing Education credits.
