FAQ
1. What is Palo Alto ACE Certification Training?
Palo Alto ACE Certification Training is a professional training program that is designed to provide individuals with the necessary skills and knowledge to manage and operate Palo Alto Networks security platforms. The training program covers topics such as network security, firewalls, VPN, threat prevention, and more.
2. What are the benefits of getting Palo Alto ACE?
Getting Palo Alto ACE certification has several benefits, such as:
· Recognition as a certified Palo Alto Networks expert
· Increased job opportunities and salary potential
· Enhanced technical skills and knowledge in managing and operating Palo Alto Networks security platforms
· Ability to demonstrate proficiency in network security and threat prevention
3. How long is the Palo Alto ACE training program?
The duration of the Palo Alto ACE training program may vary depending on the training provider. Typically, it takes around 40-50 Hours to complete the course.
4. What is the mode of Palo Alto ACE training - online or offline?
Palo Alto ACE training programs are available both online and offline. Online training allows students to learn at their own pace and from anywhere with an internet connection, while offline training provides a more traditional classroom experience.
5. What are the prerequisites for the Palo Alto ACE course?
The prerequisites for the Palo Alto ACE course may individuals should have a basic understanding of networking and security concepts before enrolling in the course.
6. What is the fee structure and are there any discounts available?
The fee structure for the Palo Alto ACE training program can vary depending on the in which time you Enroll in this course. Discounts may be available for early registration, group registration, or for certain categories of learners, such as students or veterans.
7. What are the job opportunities after completing the Palo Alto ACE training?
Completing the Palo Alto ACE training program can open several job opportunities, such as Network Security Engineer, Security Analyst, Firewall Engineer, Security Consultant, and more.
8. How can I Enroll for Palo Alto ACE Online?
Individuals can enroll for the Palo Alto ACE training Online by you can go Net Expert Solutions Website (www.nexpertsolutions.com) as well as NES Physical Center.
9. How do I register for the Palo Alto ACE certification exam?
To register for the Palo Alto ACE certification exam, individuals can visit the Palo Alto Networks website, create an account, and register for the exam. The exam can be taken at a Pearson VUE testing center.

Getting Palo Alto Panorama certification demonstrates your proficiency in using the platform and enhances your credibility as a network security professional. It can also increase your chances of getting hired or promoted in a network security role.

Overview
The NCNE Master Program: A Guaranteed Way to a High-Paying Job.
Welcome to the NCNE Master Program, a comprehensive 12-month course Design by Net Expert Solutions that is designed to equip you with the skills and knowledge required to excel in the field of networking and cloud computing. Our program offers a 100% job guarantee, ensuring that you have the necessary skills and experience to secure a job in this highly competitive field.
Course Overview:
The NCNE Master Program is a rigorous course that covers a range of topics and technologies in the networking and cloud computing domain. Our curriculum is designed by industry experts, ensuring that you receive hands-on training on the latest tools and technologies. The course includes the following modules:
CCNA:
Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) is an entry-level certification that is highly valued in the networking industry. In this module, you will learn about the fundamentals of networking, including LAN and WAN technologies, routing protocols, and network security.
CCNP:
The Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification is a more advanced certification that builds on the concepts covered in the CCNA module. In this module, you will learn about advanced networking concepts, including BGP, MPLS, and QoS.
AWS:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a popular cloud computing platform that is widely used by businesses of all sizes. In this module, you will learn about the AWS platform, including EC2, S3, and RDS.
Azure:
Microsoft Azure is another popular cloud computing platform that is widely used in the industry. In this module, you will learn about the Azure platform, including Virtual Machines, Storage, and Azure Active Directory.
MCSA:
The Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) certification is an entry-level certification that is designed for IT professionals who want to demonstrate their skills in Windows Server administration. In this module, you will learn about Windows Server 2016, including installation, configuration, and management.
Linux:
Linux is a popular operating system that is widely used in the industry. In this module, you will learn about the fundamentals of Linux, including the Linux command line, file systems, and networking.
Professional Development (PD) Classes:
In addition to the technical modules, the NCNE Master Program also includes professional development classes that will help you develop your soft skills. These classes include communication skills, leadership skills, and time management.
The NCNE Master Program is a comprehensive course that is designed to provide you with the skills and knowledge required to excel in the networking and cloud computing domain. Net Expert Solutions offers a 100% job guarantee, ensuring that you have the necessary skills and experience to secure a job in this highly competitive field. Enroll today and take the first step towards a successful career in networking and cloud computing.
Course Duration:
The CCNA to CCIE Enterprise course is an 250 Hours program that covers a range of topics in-depth. Our comprehensive curriculum and expert instructors ensure that you'll have all the skills and knowledge you need to succeed in your career.

Overview
Get certified in the most in-demand enterprise networking courses with CCNA to CCIE Enterprise.
Are you interested in advancing your career in network engineering? Our CCNA to CCIE Enterprise course offers a comprehensive training program that covers the essential concepts and hands-on experience to prepare you for a successful career in enterprise networking.
Our program is designed to give you a complete understanding of Cisco's enterprise networking technologies, including routing, switching, and wireless. The course covers a range of topics, from fundamental networking principles to advanced enterprise infrastructure concepts.
By the end of the course, you'll be equipped with the skills and knowledge needed to configure, troubleshoot, and maintain complex enterprise networks. Our expert instructors will guide you through every step of the process, using hands-on labs and real-world scenarios to give you practical experience with the technologies you'll be using on the job.
In addition to providing top-notch training, we also offer a 100% job guarantee to our students. We understand how important it is to have a successful career after completing a training program, which is why we provide job placement assistance and career support to all of our graduates.
Included Courses:
CCNA
CCNP Enterprise
CCIE Enterprise
CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
is an entry-level certification that provides the foundation for networking concepts. The CCNA course covers the basics of networking, such as IP addressing, routing protocols, LAN and WAN technologies, network security, and more. By completing this course, you'll gain a strong understanding of network fundamentals and be prepared to take the CCNA certification exam.
CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional)
Enterprise is an intermediate-level certification that focuses on advanced enterprise networking solutions. The CCNP Enterprise course covers topics such as advanced routing, switching, troubleshooting, security, and wireless networking. This course builds on the knowledge gained in the CCNA course and prepares students for the CCNP Enterprise certification exam.
CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert)
Enterprise is an expert-level certification that validates the skills and knowledge required to design, implement, and troubleshoot complex enterprise networks. The CCIE Enterprise course covers advanced topics such as network automation, design principles, and network architecture. This course builds on the knowledge gained in the CCNA and CCNP Enterprise courses and prepares students for the CCIE Enterprise certification exam.
In addition to the comprehensive training program, we also provide job placement assistance and career support to all of our students. Our 100% job guarantee ensures that you'll be ready to start your career in enterprise networking after completing the course.
Enroll in our CCNA to CCIE Enterprise course today and take the first step towards a successful career in enterprise networking!
Course Duration:
The CCNA to CCIE Enterprise course is an 200 Hours program that covers a range of topics in-depth. Our comprehensive curriculum and expert instructors ensure that you'll have all the skills and knowledge you need to succeed in your career.

Overview
Get hands-on experience with the latest firewall technologies from Cisco, Check Point, and Palo Alto.
Welcome to our new course - Multi Vendor Firewall. In this course, we offer 100% job guarantee to our students. Our course covers various types of firewalls from different vendors, including Cisco Firepower, CCSA, CCSE, and Palo Alto.
With this course, you will get hands-on training on configuring and managing firewall devices. Our course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of firewall technologies and their implementation. The course will be taught by certified experts with years of experience in the industry.
Included Courses:
Our Multi Vendor Firewall course includes the following courses:
Cisco Firepower:
Cisco Firepower is a unified next-generation firewall platform that provides advanced threat protection and security analytics. In this course, students will learn how to configure, deploy and manage Cisco Firepower firewall.
Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA):
Check Point CCSA certification is designed for security administrators who want to manage and configure Check Point Security solutions. In this course, students will learn how to configure, deploy and manage Check Point firewalls.
Check Point Certified Security Expert (CCSE):
Check Point CCSE certification is designed for security experts who want to manage and configure advanced Check Point Security solutions. In this course, students will learn how to configure, deploy and manage advanced Check Point firewalls.
Palo Alto Networks Firewall:
Palo Alto Networks Firewall is a next-generation firewall that provides advanced threat protection and network security. In this course, students will learn how to configure, deploy and manage Palo Alto firewalls.
We are committed to providing our students with the best training and career opportunities. Upon completion of our Multi Vendor Firewall course, we offer 100% job guarantee to our students. Our placement team works closely with leading companies in the cybersecurity industry to ensure that our students get the best job opportunities.
Enroll now in our Multi Vendor Firewall course and take the first step towards a successful career in the cybersecurity industry. Our experienced trainers will provide you with hands-on training and practical experience to prepare you for the challenges of the real-world.
Course Duration:
The Multi-Vendor Firewall course is a 7 to 8 months program that covers all the above-mentioned courses. The course is designed to provide students with in-depth knowledge of firewall technologies and their practical applications.

Overview
Get hands-on experience with the latest Cloud technologies from Cisco, Check Point, and Palo Alto.
Net Expert Solutions Provides Cloud computing has revolutionized the IT industry and has become a crucial component of modern-day businesses. With the increasing demand for cloud solutions, there is a high demand for skilled professionals who can design, deploy and manage cloud infrastructure. Our Cloud Expert Multi-Vendor Cloud course is designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to become experts in the field of cloud computing.
Course Overview:
The Net Expert Solutions Provides Cloud Expert Multi-Vendor Cloud course is an 8-month program that covers all the essential aspects of cloud computing. It includes the following courses:
CCNA:
The Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification is a foundational certification for network engineers, covering the basics of networking, including routing and switching. This course will provide you with a strong foundation in networking, which is essential for working in the cloud.
AWS Associate:
The AWS Associate certification is a mid-level certification that demonstrates expertise in designing and deploying scalable systems on Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this course, you will learn how to use AWS services such as EC2, S3, and RDS to build scalable, fault-tolerant systems in the cloud.
AWS Professional:
The AWS Professional certification is a high-level certification that demonstrates mastery of AWS services and best practices. This course covers advanced topics such as designing for high availability, implementing security and compliance, and optimizing cost and performance in the cloud.
Azure AZ-104:
The Azure Administrator Associate certification is a mid-level certification that demonstrates expertise in implementing, monitoring, and maintaining Microsoft Azure solutions. In this course, you will learn how to deploy and manage Azure virtual machines, configure and manage Azure storage, and implement Azure networking.
GCA:
The Google Cloud Architect certification is a high-level certification that demonstrates mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and infrastructure. In this course, you will learn how to design and implement scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant cloud solutions on GCP.
GCP:
The Google Cloud Professional certification is a mid-level certification that demonstrates expertise in deploying and managing applications on GCP. This course covers advanced topics such as designing for scalability and availability, implementing security and compliance, and optimizing cost and performance in the cloud.
After completing the Cloud Expert Multi-Vendor Cloud course, students will be well-equipped to handle a wide range of job roles such as Cloud Architect, Cloud Engineer, Cloud Developer, and Cloud Administrator. The demand for cloud professionals is high, and this course guarantees 100% job placement for its students.
The Net Expert Solutions Provides Cloud Expert Multi-Vendor Cloud course is a comprehensive program that covers all the essential aspects of cloud computing. It is designed to provide students with the necessary skills and knowledge to become experts in the field of cloud computing. With 100% job placement guarantee, this course is an excellent investment for anyone looking to pursue a career in cloud computing.
Course Duration:
The Multi-Vendor Cloud course is a 150 Hours program that covers all the above-mentioned courses. The course is designed to provide students with in-depth knowledge of Cloud technologies and their practical applications.

Overview

Welcome to Net Expert Solutions, a leading institute dedicated to providing top-notch training in the field of cybersecurity. We are excited to introduce our Master Program in Security, an intensive 8-month course designed to equip aspiring professionals with the skills and knowledge required to excel in the dynamic world of cybersecurity. This program combines industry-leading courses, including Firepower, CCSA, CCSE, and Palo Alto, to provide a comprehensive learning experience. Join us and become a certified expert in network security.
Firepower:
Dive into the world of Firepower and gain expertise in advanced techniques to safeguard networks against evolving threats. Learn effective network defense, threat prevention, and infrastructure management through hands-on training and real-world scenarios.
CCSA (Check Point Certified Security Administrator):
Become a certified Check Point Security Administrator and master the comprehensive suite of Check Point security products. Gain skills in firewall management, network monitoring, and threat detection, ensuring robust security for network infrastructures.
CCSE (Check Point Certified Security Expert):
Advance your career with the CCSE certification, which enhances your expertise in Check Point security solutions. Learn advanced firewall configuration, VPN implementation, and advanced troubleshooting techniques to effectively protect networks against sophisticated attacks.
Palo Alto Networks:
Become a certified Palo Alto Networks Security professional and gain in-depth knowledge of Palo Alto's cutting-edge security technologies. Learn firewall configuration, VPN implementation, and threat prevention mechanisms to safeguard critical infrastructures against cyber threats.
Course Highlights:
Comprehensive Curriculum:

Learn from experienced industry professionals who bring their real-world expertise into the classroom. Our instructors are dedicated to providing engaging and interactive sessions that enhance your learning experience.
Hands-on Practical Experience:
Gain practical experience through hands-on labs, real-world simulations, and case studies. Apply your knowledge in a practical setting, ensuring you are well-prepared to tackle real-world cybersecurity challenges.
Flexible Schedule:
We understand the demands of a busy lifestyle. Our program offers a flexible schedule, allowing you to balance your professional and personal commitments while pursuing your cybersecurity career goals.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ):
Q1: How long is the Master Program in Security?
The Master Program in Security is an intensive 8-month course that covers the included courses of Firepower, CCSA, CCSE, and Palo Alto Networks. The duration is designed to provide a comprehensive learning experience and ensure you gain in-depth knowledge and skills.
Q2: What are the prerequisites for this program?
Basic knowledge of networking concepts is recommended, but not mandatory. We welcome learners at different levels of experience, and our instructors will guide you through the program to ensure your success.
Q3: How is the program delivered?
The program is delivered through a blended learning approach, combining online modules, live virtual sessions, hands-on labs, and assessments. You can access course materials and interact with instructors and peers through our intuitive online learning platform.
Q4: Will I receive certifications upon completion?
Yes, upon successful completion of the Master Program in Security, you will receive certifications for each course completed, including Firepower, CCSA, CCSE, and Palo Alto Networks. These industry-recognized certifications validate your expertise and enhance your career prospects.
Q5: Can I get career support after completing the program?
Absolutely! We provide career support services to our students, including job placement assistance, resume building, and interview preparation. We are committed to helping you launch or advance your career in the cybersecurity domain.
Securing Networks with Cisco Firepower v1.0 (300-710)
Exam Description:
Securing Networks with Cisco Firepower v1.0 (SNCF 300-710) is a 90-minute exam associated with the CCNP Security Certification. This exam tests a candidate's knowledge of Cisco Firepower® Threat Defense and Firepower®, including policy configurations, integrations, deployments, management and troubleshooting. These courses, Securing Networks with Cisco Firepower, and Securing Networks with Cisco Firepower Next-Generation Intrusion Prevention System helps candidates prepare for this exam.
The following topics are general guidelines for the content likely to be included on the exam. However, other related topics may also appear on any specific delivery of the exam. To better reflect the contents of the exam and for clarity purposes, the guidelines below may change at any time without notice.
30% 1.0 Deployment
1.1 Implement NGFW modes
1.2 Implement NGIPS modes
1.3 Implement high availability options
1.4 Describe IRB configurations
1.4 Describe IRB configurations
2.1 Configure system settings in Cisco Firepower Management Center
2.2 Configure these policies in Cisco Firepower Management Center
2.3 Configure these features using Cisco Firepower Management Center
2.4 Configure objects using Firepower Management Center
2.5 Configure devices using Firepower Management Center
25% 3.0 Management and Troubleshooting
3.1 Troubleshoot with FMC CLI and GU
3.2 Configure dashboards and reporting in FMC
3.3 Troubleshoot using packet capture procedures
3.4 Analyze risk and standard reports
15% 4.0 Integration
4.1 Configure Cisco AMP for Networks in Firepower Management Center
4.2 Configure Cisco AMP for Endpoints in Firepower Management Center
4.3 Implement Threat Intelligence Director for third-party security intelligence feeds
4.4 Describe using Cisco Threat Response for security investigations
4.5 Describe Cisco FMC PxGrid Integration with Cisco Identify Services Engine (ISE)
4.6 Describe Rapid Threat Containment (RTC) functionality within Firepower Management Center

CHECK POINT CYBER SECURITY ADMINISTRATOR (CCSA) R80.10
COURSE GOAL:
Provide an understanding of basic concepts and skills necessary to configure Check Point Security Gateway and Management Software Blades.
COURSE TOPICS
Introduction to Check Point Technology
Security Policy Management
Policy Layers
Check Point Security Solutions and Licensing
Traffic Visibility
Basic Concepts of VPN
Managing User Access
Working with ClusterXL
Administrator Task Implementation
LAB EXERCISES
Working with Gaia Portal
Modifying an Existing Security Policy
Configuring Hide and Static NAT
Managing Administrator Access
Installing and Managing a Remote Security Gateway
Managing Backups
Defining Access Control Policy Layers
Defining and Sharing Security Policy Layers
Working with Licenses and Contracts
Working with Check Point Logs
Maintaining Check Point Logs
Configuring a Site-to-Site VPN
Providing User Access
Working with Cluster XL
Verifying Network Compliance
Working with CP View
COURSE OBJECTIVES
Interpret the concept of a Firewall and understand the mechanisms used for controlling network traffic.
• Describe the key elements of Check Point’s unified Security Management Architecture.
Recognize SmartConsole features, functions and tools.
Understand Check Point deployment options.
Describe the basic functions of Gaia.
Describe the essential elements of a Security Policy.
Understand how traffic inspection takes place in a unified Security Policy.
Summarize how administration roles and permissions assist in managing policy.
Recall how to implement backup techniques
Understand the Check Point policy layer concept.
Recognize Check Point security solutions and products and how they work to protect your network.
Understand licensing and contract requirements for Check Point security products.
Identify tools designed to monitor data, determine threats and recognize performance improvements.
Identify tools designed to respond quickly and efficiently to changes in gateways, tunnels, remote users, traffic flow patterns, and other activities.
Understand Site-to-Site and Remote Access VPN deployments and communities.
Understand how to analyze and interpret VPN traffic
Recognize how to define users and user groups.
Understand how to manage user access for internal and external users.
Understand the basic concepts of ClusterXL technology and its advantages.
Understand how to perform periodic administrator tasks as specified in administrator job descriptions.

Evaluating Threats with SmartEvent

Reviewing Threat Prevention Settings and Protections
Deploying Threat Emulation and Threat Extraction
COURSE OBJECTIVES
Identify advanced CLI commands.
Understand system management procedures, including how to perform system upgrades and apply patches and hotfixes.
Describe the Check Point Firewall infrastructure.
Describe advanced methods of gathering important gateway data using CPView and CPInfo.
Recognize how Check Point’s flexible API architecture supports automation and orchestration.
Discuss advanced ClusterXL functions
Describe VRRP network redundancy advantages.
Undersand how SecureXL acceleration technology is used to enhance and improve performance.
Understand how CoreXL acceleration technology is used to enhance and improve performance.
Identify the SmartEvent components that store network activity logs and identify events
Discuss the SmartEvent process that determines which network activities may lead to security issues.
Discuss the Mobile Access Software Blace and how it secures communication and data.
Understand Mobile Access deployment options.
Recognize Check Point Remote Access solutions
Discuss Check Point Capsule components and how they protect mobile devices and business documents
Discuss diferent Check Point Solutions for attacks such as zero-day and Advanced Persistent Threats.
Understand how SandBlast, Threat Emulation, and Threat Extraction prevent security incidents.
Identify how Check Point Mobile Threat Prevention can help protect data accessed on company-issued smartphones and tablets
